intro: Rest and Relaxation is an introductory Alliance quest directing newly trained adventurers from Northshire south along the road to the Lion's Pride Inn. Run by Innkeeper Farley, the bustling Goldshire tavern offers food, drink, and a warm hearth for those seeking a reprieve from the road.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Every adventurer should rest when exhaustion sets in - and there is no finer place to get rest and relaxation than at the Lion's Pride Inn!
My best friend, Innkeeper Farley, runs the Lion's Pride. If you tell him I sent you, he may give you the special discounted rates on food and drink.
To find the Lion's Pride Inn, travel south along the road from here -- you can't miss it!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Rest and relaxation for the tired and cold -- that's our motto! Please, take a seat by the fire and rest your weary bones.
Would you like to try a sampling of some of our fine food and drink?
